subtasks: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
Reopen the holder lid to reseat the raised rear-right egg in its cup. Keep the other three eggs in their cups.
Settle the rear-right egg down into its own cup in the open holder. Keep the other three eggs seated.
Close the egg holder lid fully over the four eggs, then open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
Immediately release the lid, fully open both grippers, and return both arms to their initial poses.
